title: Reasons for Lower Proportion of Fresh Graduates in Full-time Employment and Extent of Help from GRaduate Industry Traineeship Programme
what_it_is: Reasons for Lower Proportion of Fresh Graduates in Full-time Employment and Extent of Help from GRaduate Industry Traineeship Programme

sections.label: Graduate employment rates 2025
sections.summary: About 9,300 of the 2025 cohort, or 52%, were employed by June, with permanent employment at 44% versus 37% in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As of June this year, around 9,300 graduates from the 2025 cohort, or 52%, were employed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The proportion of graduates in permanent employment has also increased, at about 44% in 2025 compared to 37% in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The employment rate of the 2024 cohort has risen from 48%, as mentioned earlier, to 88% this June.

sections.label: SGUT trainee employment rate
sections.summary: Close to 90% of SGUT trainees found regular employment within six months after completion.

sentences.text: To Ms Eileen Chong's question, close to 90% of SGUT trainees found regular employment within six months after completion.

sections.label: GRIT initial places
sections.summary: GRIT started with an initial capacity of 800 places, 500 private sector and 300 public sector.

sentences.text: To Mr Gerald Giam's and Ms Poh Li San's question on the initial number of places, we have started GRIT with an initial capacity of 800 places – 500 private sector and 300 public sector.

sections.label: Traineeship allowance cap
sections.summary: The traineeship allowance maximum was capped at $2,400, about half the median starting salary of autonomous university fresh graduates.

sentences.text: To Mr Louis Chua's question on how we determined the traineeship allowance, we capped the maximum at $2,400, which is approximately half of the median starting salary of fresh graduates from autonomous universities.

sections.label: GRIT checks and support
sections.summary: WSG will check host companies' recent retrenchments, the allowance is lower than Mid-Career Pathways Programme attachments, and support may be expanded.

sentences.text: To Mr Ng Shi Xuan's question, WSG will also conduct checks on host companies' recent retrenchment activities to ensure that the traineeship roles are not similar to that of impacted workers.
Moreover, the traineeship allowance is calibrated to be lower than what host organisations can receive for mature individuals who are undergoing attachments under the Mid-Career Pathways Programme.
The Government stands ready to roll out further support if necessary.

We are prepared to increase traineeship places and extend the programme if economic conditions worsen, or if there is demand for more traineeship places due to good outcomes for both graduates and employers.

sections.label: GRIT temporary scheme
sections.summary: GRIT is intended to be a temporary scheme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: GRIT is intended to be a temporary scheme.

sections.label: GDP year-on-year growth
sections.summary: GDP grew year on year by 4.3%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Our GDP grew year on year by 4.3%.

sections.label: Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package measures
sections.summary: Measures were announced at the MOM Committee of Supply Budget on the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package, and NTUC with agencies put up a $200 million package for Company Training Committees.

sentences.text: There is also a whole slew of measures that I had announced at the MOM Committee of Supply (COS) Budget this year on the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package.
And the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC), working with the different agencies, has put up a $200 million package to develop Company Training Committees with all of the different companies.

sections.label: GRIT companies offering traineeships
sections.summary: Close to 50 growth-sector companies committed to offering GRIT places across sectors including financial services, manufacturing, ICT and media, wholesale trade and professional services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For the purpose of GRIT, we have worked with close to 50 companies in the growth sector and they have committed to offering places under the GRIT programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: They span quite a diverse range of sectors, including financial services, manufacturing, the information and communications technology (ICT) and media sector, wholesale trade and professional services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I can share with Members a list of some of these companies, which includes prominent industry leaders – OCBC, DBS, Singapore Technologies, the semi-conductor companies, Micron, Sembcorp, Grab, Sea, Standard Chartered Bank – they have all stepped forward to offer meaningful traineeship opportunities.

sections.label: GRIT@Gov trainee employment question
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Government would commit to offering employment to GRIT@Gov trainees or expect agencies to hire them permanently, and the Government hopes its 300 places inspire trainees to join.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gho Sze Kee (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: With regards to the GRIT@Gov Programme, would the Government commit to offering employment to trainees at the end of their traineeship, or at least set a clear expectation that the Government agencies should seek to hire these trainees into permanent roles rather than treating the programme as a stop gap measure?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Certainly, from the Government's perspective, the 300 places offered by the Government agencies, we hope that the moment they come on board, that industrial attachment, would indeed inspire and encourage many of these young trainees to sign up and join the Government.

sections.label: WSG conversion allowance subsidies
sections.summary: WSG will encourage host organisations to offer full-time employment and provide allowance subsidies to convert GRIT trainees who completed at least three months.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Lastly, as I said, to strengthen the pathway to full-time employment, WSG will strongly encourage host organisations to offer full-time employment where possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And to support host organisations to do so, to get them to convert these GRIT trainees earlier even before the traineeships end, we will continue to provide allowance subsidies for host organisations to convert the trainees who have completed at least three months.

sections.label: Traineeships versus job-seeking graduates
sections.summary: The 800 initial traineeship positions are about half of the roughly 1,700 increase in job-seeking fresh graduates in the 2025 cohort compared to 2024.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The delta of fresh graduates looking for jobs, that increase in numbers, is about 1,700.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, this initial number, and let me highlight and underscore, is an initial number of 800 traineeship positions, is actually approximately half of the increase in the number of job-seeking graduates in the 2025 cohort, compared to the 2024 cohort at the same point in June last year.

sections.label: Unemployed graduates and full-time jobs
sections.summary: The objective is to channel as many graduates as possible into full-time jobs, as unemployed graduates gradually fall and 30,000 full-time vacancies exist.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Because of that, as a result of the number of unemployed graduates gradually falling, because more of them land jobs overtime, because, as I have said, there are also 30,000 full-time job vacancies for fresh graduates that that were available, our end objective is to channel as many graduates as possible into full-time jobs.

sections.label: Resident unemployment rates
sections.summary: The resident long-term unemployment rate is below 1% and spot unemployment is about 2.8% to 2.9%, with 2% to 2.1% being churn.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: If you look at where we are today, the resident long-term unemployment rate is still very low, below 1%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And the spot unemployment is about just below 3%, about 2.8%, 2.9%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: At below 1%, a long-term unemployment rate, that 2% to 2.1% is actually churn.
